description: Card payments with Razorpay, with saved cards and subscriptions
name: Razorpay

images.title: Pay without leaving the checkout
images.description: Shoppers pay in Razorpay's secure window, and their card is saved for renewals and later charges.

images.title: Take the money when you choose
images.description: Capture on order or within 5 days, charge the saved card, and refund from the order. A payment is never taken twice.

images.title: Subscriptions renew on the saved card
images.description: Renewals are charged on Razorpay automatically, with no checkout for the customer.

images.title: Set up in minutes
images.description: Choose Razorpay as the payment gateway for credit cards, paste your API keys and save.
